WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(n.cost),2) AS cost,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost),2) AS gross_margin
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4 AND cs.region='South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 14

SELECT 'multi_current_sku' k, count(*)::VARCHAR v FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY sku HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_current_store', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current GROUP BY store_id HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_sales_prod', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.product_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_sales_store', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store p ON p.store_key=f.store_key WHERE p.store_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_ret_prod', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.product_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_ret_store', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store p ON p.store_key=f.store_key WHERE p.store_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_no_sale', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_or_null_sales_Q4', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND (net_amount IS NULL OR quantity<=0 OR standard_cost IS NULL)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_dates', min(sale_date)::VARCHAR||' '||max(sale_date)::VARCHAR FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'zzcat', string_agg(DISTINCT category, ',') FROM dim_product

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(x.v) AS net FROM (
    SELECT f.store_key, f.net_amount v FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.store_key, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27') x
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=x.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE cs.region='South' GROUP BY 1),
rpt AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.store_id, round(m.net,2) mine, round(r.net,2) rpt, round(m.net-r.net,2) diff FROM mine m LEFT JOIN rpt r USING(store_id) ORDER BY 1
